body: Important warning, pero trend-wise huwag nating gawing epidemic chart ang isang official alert. The article proves the scam pattern exists; hindi nito sinusukat kung gaano kabilis tumataas ang incidence. To call it accelerating, kailangan natin ng complaint counts over time, repeated alerts, or independent enforcement data. Meanwhile, the behavioral lesson stands kahit walang trend claim. Minsan ang tamang graph ay walang upward arrow—may malaking STOP sign lang.

claims.text: The current evidence establishes the recovery-scam pattern but is insufficient by itself to establish that incidence is accelerating.
claims.basis: The cited Consumer Affairs Agency warning documents the scam type, while the article provides no time-series incidence data.
